units.source_text: 诸事都已看清，心中好不悲伤！

en.t: Now that everything was clear to him, his heart was filled with sorrow.

units.source_text: 又想：“世间最靠不住的，无过于人心了！

en.t: He thought again, "In this world, nothing is less reliable than the human heart.

units.source_text: 这浮舟的模样端庄温雅，却不道是个水性杨花的女子，

en.t: Ukifune looks so dignified and gentle, yet who would have thought she was such a fickle woman,

units.source_text: 和匂亲王倒是志同道合的一对。”

en.t: and she and Prince Niou are actually a pair well suited to one another."

units.source_text: 他想到这里，自己准备退出，而把浮舟让给匂亲王。

en.t: Thinking this far, he was ready to withdraw and give Ukifune up to Prince Niou.

units.source_text: 然而又想：“如果我当初是想娶她为正夫人的，倒要讲究。

en.t: But then he thought again, "If I had meant from the beginning to take her as my principal wife, then such things would matter.

units.source_text: 但事实并非如此，所以还不如把她当作情妇，听其所为吧。

en.t: But that is not the case, so perhaps I should simply treat her as a mistress and let her do as she pleases.

units.source_text: 叫我从此和她断绝往来，倒是舍不得的。”

en.t: To break off all relations with her from now on would still be more than I can bear."

units.source_text: 如此反复考虑，令人觉得可笑。

en.t: His wavering thoughts went back and forth like this, almost laughably.

units.source_text: 他又想：“我倘嫌恶了她，把她抛弃，则匂亲王必然取了她去，据为己有。

en.t: He thought again, "If I grow disgusted with her and cast her aside, Prince Niou will surely take her and make her his own.

units.source_text: 但他绝不会考虑到这女子日后的不幸。

en.t: But he will never think about the misfortune that may befall this woman later.

units.source_text: 起初热爱、后来玩腻了送给大公主当侍女的女子，至今已有二三人。

en.t: There have already been two or three women whom he loved passionately at first, then tired of and sent to serve the elder princess.

units.source_text: 如果浮舟也被如此处理，叫我看到、听到了，多么难过啊！”

en.t: If Ukifune too were treated in that way, how painful it would be for me to see or hear of it!"

units.source_text: 他终于舍不得她。

en.t: In the end, he could not bring himself to give her up.

units.source_text: 为欲探明情况，写一封信给她。

en.t: Wanting to find out the truth, he wrote her a letter.

units.source_text: 趁无人在旁之时，召唤那个随从来前，

en.t: When no one else was nearby, he summoned that attendant to him,

units.source_text: 问他：“道定朝臣近来还是常和仲信家的女儿往来么？”

en.t: and asked him, "Has Lord Michisada still been visiting Nakatsune's daughter often lately?"

units.source_text: 随从答道：“是。”

en.t: The attendant replied, "Yes."

units.source_text: 又问：“派到宇治去的，常常是你所说起的那个男仆么？

en.t: He asked again, "Is the one often sent to Uji the manservant you mentioned before?

units.source_text: ……那边的女子一时家境衰落了，道定不知底细，也想去向她求爱呢。

en.t: ...The woman there suffered a temporary decline in her family's circumstances, and Michisada, not knowing the details, has also been thinking of courting her.
